steps: A working build exists (APK or playable game).
Compared against the top apps like it: what they do, what users hate about them.
The release testing kit passed: build + signing, screen bot, Android versions and sizes, real phone.
Store pictures, listing text and privacy page made and matching the build.
Free store accounts made (Galaxy Store, itch.io; Google Play costs US$25).
Uploaded to a store and waiting for review.
People can download it from a store.

groups.tool: Personal and business tools (not for a store)
groups.game: Games (now built by zac's separate games project)

apps.name: Nonet
apps.what: Daily sudoku with a shareable result card, no ads, works offline.

next.what: Pass the release testing kit (Nonet is first in line), then the free Galaxy Store and itch.io sign-ups.

apps.waiting: zac: try it on a real phone, and make the 2 free store accounts (about 30 min).
apps.future: Best money chance of the apps built so far. Sudoku players' top complaint is too many ads, and Nonet has none. Store page stays on hold until the final pick.
apps.quality_note: store-ready build, all screens pass 320-390 px (8 Nov)

apps.name: Survive Offline
apps.what: Offline survival and first-aid guide: 188 emergency cards, questions, guided steps, SOS light.

next.what: Real-phone check (torch, GPS, Back button) and a first-aid review of the cards, then the release testing kit.

apps.waiting: zac: real-phone check and a first-aid-trained person to read the cards.
apps.future: Small market, but very well made. Worth putting on the free stores as a useful app; don't expect much money.

apps.name: Bargain Finder
apps.what: Share or screenshot a Marketplace, Carsales or Gumtree listing and it says if the price is a bargain (cars, caravans, bikes, watches).

next.what: Run the release testing kit, then make store pictures and a privacy page.

apps.waiting: Nothing from zac right now. Weak spot: the guide prices are zac's own estimates.
apps.future: Australia first, then NZ, UK and Canada. The US is crowded (Swoopa, Underpriced).
apps.quality_note: about 70 as a personal tool, 55 as a store app (8 Nov review)

apps.name: Ryan's Vibe (was Pulse Routine)
apps.what: Wellness routine app: today check-in, routines, tracker, breathing, stretches, health helper, 5 games. English and Thai.

next.what: zac picks the final name ("Vibe" may clash with Resona's trademark) and the package name before the first upload.

apps.waiting: zac: final name and package name, back up pulse-release.jks, a public privacy page. Google Play needs US$25 and 12 testers for 14 days, so free stores come first.
apps.future: Wellness apps sell well but users hate paywalls. Free with no paywall is a real edge. The name must be settled first.
apps.quality_note: 582 controls tested in English, Thai and dark mode, 0 errors (7-8 Nov)

apps.name: Quiet Flights Finder
apps.what: Shows which months planes are emptiest on your routes (Australia, USA, Europe, Brazil, Japan open data).

next.what: Raise minSdk to 26, build the Play .aab on the PC, then run the full release kit

apps.waiting: zac: test APK 1.10 on a real phone
apps.future: Open data, so it is cheap to keep fresh. Travel apps score low on complaints; the visitor count from the Reddit post will tell more.

next.what: Rebuild with new data when wanted (phone-app kit).

apps.future: Personal tool, not for a store.
